_help: Demo users for `node scripts/seed-demo.mjs`. Edit names/ages/grades/styles here and re-run the script. Names are the key: a name that already exists is skipped (rows are never changed or deleted); to change an existing user, reset with `SPACETIME_DB=voice-tutor node scripts/publish.mjs --clear` and re-run. Module limits: name 1-40 chars (teacher 1-60), age 5-18, grade 0-13, style max 200 chars. Avoid the 20 simulated students' names (shared/src/classroom/simStudents.ts: Mia Hoffmann, Jonas Becker, ...).
